The Morning Sweep Situational Adjustment primitive aggregates external metrics into a unified pressure signal, modeled as a log-linear combination of normalized inputs. The QB Disguise Blitz Profile introduces a conditional vulnerability term that modifies this signal based on quarterback-specific behavior. The Reasoning Orchestrator coordinates these into a 26-layer ContextPacket, which is processed through 5 reasoning tracks—each representing a distinct domain of influence (market, matchup, etc.). These tracks form a hierarchical Bayesian network where each layer's output feeds into the next. Failure modes include missing data in external charting or misalignment between coach and player profiles. The system enforces anti-collinearity by ensuring each track contributes unique information to the final state transition.
